The '''''Folna''''' was a [[Agave-class picket ship|''Agave''-class picket ship]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]], commanded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Foag]], and captained by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Madis]].

==History==
During the [[Black Fleet Crisis]], the ''Folna'' traveled to the [[ILC-905 system]] as part of a small task force led by the [[Majestic-class heavy cruiser|cruiser]] [[Indomitable (Majestic-class)|''Indomitable'']]&mdash;commanded by [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Turk Brand|Brand]]&mdash;and including the [[Warrior-class gunship|gunship]] [[Vanguard (Warrior-class)|''Vanguard'']]. The task force discovered that the system was being used as a jump point for the [[Yevetha]]. Together, they engaged the Yevetha forces and won the eleven minute [[Battle of ILC-905]].
